Privacy

How we handle your information

ADL Consultancy Ltd are committed to ensuring that your personal information is protected and have a number of robust physical and electronic security measures in place. Any information you supply us via this form will be used solely to respond to your enquiry, arrange a meeting and provide a quotation for ISO support.

We will not sell, lease or distribute your personal information to third parties under any circumstances. We will only release your personal information to a third party if we have your explicit consent or are required by law to do so. Your personal information will be deleted from our systems when deemed it is no longer needed or upon your request.

Cookies

Our cookie statement

We use Google Analytics first-party tracking cookies to collect anonymous traffic data about your use of this website. This information is stored by Google and subject to their privacy policy. Google Analytics collects information such as pages you visit on this site, the browser and operating system you use as well as the time spent viewing pages.

The purpose of this information is to monitor traffic through the site, in order to help us improve the site for future visitors. Whilst your exact location and IP address may be known by Google, it is unknown by ADL Consultancy Ltd. This results in us only being aware of your general location and, therefore, the cookies currently used contain no personally identifiable information. You can prevent or limit the use of cookies by adjusting the settings on your browser.
